# ClientLens

> ClientLens is an independent app studio that builds focused, easy-to-use apps for iPhone and Android. Contact: support@clientlens.co

## Apps

- [Contacts Backup, Export, Merge](https://clientlens.co/contacts-backup/): iPhone and Android app that backs up every contact to a standard vCard (.vcf) file, exports contacts to Excel, CSV or JSON, restores from a backup with a preview, and merges duplicate contacts with undo. No account and no server; the app makes no network connections of its own, so the developer never receives contact data. Backups stay in the app and in the user's own iCloud or Google device backup. Free for address books of up to 500 contacts; Pro is a one-time in-app purchase (US $4.99, local prices vary). App Store and Google Play release coming soon.

## Contacts Backup, Export, Merge

- [Transfer contacts to a new phone](https://clientlens.co/contacts-backup/transfer/): step-by-step guide with examples (iPhone to iPhone, iPhone to Android, Android to iPhone, work contacts to a personal account), plus importing without the app.
- [Help and support (FAQ)](https://clientlens.co/contacts-backup/support/): moving to a new phone, what the 500-contact free limit means, where backups are stored, restoring a single contact, undoing a merge, contact versus card counts, notes on iPhone, restoring a purchase, refunds, Android Google backup size limit, reminders.
- [Privacy policy](https://clientlens.co/contacts-backup/privacy/): the app collects no data; no analytics, ads or tracking; purchases handled by Apple or Google; how support emails are handled.
- [Terms of use](https://clientlens.co/contacts-backup/terms/): licence, Free and Pro, refunds through Apple and Google, warranty and liability.
- [Accessibility](https://clientlens.co/contacts-backup/accessibility/): VoiceOver and TalkBack support, larger text, contrast, known limits, how to report a problem.
- [Open-source acknowledgements](https://clientlens.co/contacts-backup/acknowledgements/): packages included in the app and their licences.
